results.title: Kotu ta soke takarar Atiku a ADC da duk matakan da jam'iyyar tsagin Mark ta ɗauka
results.content: Babbar kotun tarayya dake Abuja ta soke halascin shugabancin jam’iyyar ADC tsagin David Mark da dukkan wasu taruka ko zaɓuka da sauran matakai da suka ɗauka da sunan jam’iyyar.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Dangote ya ƙaddamar da aikin shimfiɗa bututun mai na dala biliyan 2.5 a Namibia
results.content: Attajirin Afrika Aliko Dangote ya ƙaddamar da aikin shimfiɗa bututu da samar da runbunan ajiyar mai na dala biliyan 2 da miliyan 500 a ƙasar Namibia, matakin da zai sauya akalar harkokin jigilar mai a kudancin Afrika.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Ƴan ta'adda sun kashe wani soja da mata mai juna biyu a harin da suka kai Taraba
results.content: Ƴan ta’adda sun kashe wani soja da wata mata mai juna biyu a wani hari da suka kai ƙauyen Sarkin Yamma dake kusa da unguwar Jeb-Jeb na ƙaramar hukumar Karim-Lamido dake jihar Taraba a tarayyar Najeriya.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Najeriya ke samun kashi 25 cikin ɗari na mace-macen mata masu juna biyu a duniya
results.content: Wasu alƙaluman Majalisar ɗinkin duniya sun nuna cewa Najeriya ke ɗauke da kashi 25 cikin 100 na mace-macen matan da ake fuskanta a lokacin haihuwa, alƙaluman da ke alamta cewa duk 1 cikin mata 22 a ƙasar ta yammacin Afrika na cikin haɗarin rasa ranta ko dai a lokacinb goyon ciki ko kuma haihuwa lamarin da ke nasaba da rashin ɗaukar matakan da suka kamata a ɓangaren kiwon lafiya.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Cristiano Ronaldo ya sanar da ritaya daga dokawa Portugal ƙwallo
results.content: Tauraron Portugal Cristiano Ronaldo ya sanar da ritaya daga dokawa ƙasar shi ƙwallo, cikin wani saƙon bidiyo da ya wallafa a shafinsa, lamarin da ke kawo ƙarshen shekaru fiye da 20 da ya shafe yana wakiltar ƙasar shi a matakin ƙwallon ƙafar duniya.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Jam'iyyar ADC ta ƙaddamar da yaƙin neman zaɓenta na ƙasa a jihar Sokoto
results.content: A Najeriya babbar jam'iyyar adawa ta ADC ta ƙaddamar da gangamin yaƙin neman zaɓenta na ƙasa jiya Laraba a jihar Sokoto, bisa jagorancin ɗan takararta da ke neman kujerar shugabancin ƙasar Alhaji Atiku Abubakar, gangamin da ke zuwa duk kuwa da matakin mahukuntan jihar ta Sokoto na rufe ofishin jam’iyyar.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Farfesa Adam Muhd Abubakar taron shekara-shekara na kasuwar hannayen jari a Najeriya
results.content: Yau ake ƙarƙare taron masu ruwa da tsaki kan hada-hadar kasuwar hannayen jari a Najeriya, wanda ya saba gudana a duk shekara.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Ƴan Najeriya 4 sun yi nasara a zaɓen tsakiyar wa'adi na Amurka
results.content: Ƴan asalin Najeriya 4 ne suka sami nasarar lashe zaɓe a zaɓen tsakiyar wa’adi da aka yi ranar 3 ga watan Nuwamba a Amurka, yayin da ake dakon sakamakon ɗan takara guda, wato Segun Adeyina, a jihar Georgia sakamakon cigaba da ƙidaya ƙuri’u da ake yi.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: An bayar da jan kati 53 yayin wani wasa a Brazil karon farko a tarihin ƙwallon ƙafa
results.content: An kafa sabon tarihin bayar da jan kati mafi yawa a tarihin ƙwallon ƙafar duniya, inda aka bada guda 53 a cikin wasa ɗaya a ƙasar Brazil.

results.title: Shugabannin ƙwadago na Afrika sun gana kan matsalar rashin aikin yi na matasa
results.content: Shugabannin Ƙungiyoyin ƙwadago daga sassa daban-daban na Afirka, sun kammala taron yini uku a birnin Abuja na Najeriya, inda suka tattauna batun yadda za a samar wa matasa ayyukan yi tare da bayar da shawarwari dangane da irin matakan da suka dace a ɗauka domin kare waɗanda suka samu kansu a yanayin da ake kira ‘’ƴan cirani’’.

results.title: Mahukuntan Guinea sun haramta ayyukan haƙar ma'adinai ba bisa ƙa'ida ba
results.content: A wani mataki na kawo karshen hakko ma’adinan ƙasar ba bisa ƙa’ida be,hukumomin Guinee Conakry suka sanar da haramta irin wannan aiki a faɗin ƙasar, lamarin da ya kai ga korar wasu ƴan ƙasar Burkina Faso zuwa ƙasarsu.

results.title: Tinubu ya aike da sabuwar buƙatar ciyo bashin sama da naira tiriliyan 10
results.content: Shugaban Najeriya Bola Ahmed Tinubu ya aike da buƙatar damar karɓo rance na dala biliyan 7.7 zuwa ga Majalisar Dokokin ƙasar, kwatankwacin naira tiriliyan 10 da biliyan 79 domin don tallafa wa wani ɓangare na giɓin kasafin kuɗin Gwamnatin Tarayya na naira tiriliyan 31 da biliyan 4 na shekarar 2026.

results.title: Teburin Gasar Zakarun Turai ya ɗauki sabon salo bayan wasannin da aka buga
results.content: Teburin gasar zakarun Turai ya ɗauki sabon salo bayan wasannin da aka buga a ranakun Talata da Laraba.

results.title: Trump ya ce yaƙin Iran ya taka rawa a kashin da jam'iyyarsa ta sha a zaɓe
results.content: Shugaba Donald Trump ya ce lallai yaƙin da Amurka da Isra'ila ke yi da Iran ya taka rawa wajen mummunar kaye da jam'iyyarsa ta sha a zaɓen tsakiyar wa'adi, yayin da jam'iyyar Democrat ta karɓe ikon Majalisar Wakilai da kuma Majalisar Dattawa.

results.title: Najeriya ta tsallaka zagayen kusa da na ƙarshe a Gasar Kofin Duniya ta mata
results.content: Najeriya ta samu nasara kan Brazil a wasan zagayen kusa da na ƙarshe na Gasar Cin Kofin Duniya ta mata ‘yan ƙasa da shekaru 17 da ke gudana a Morocco.

results.title: Tattauna wa da Jawad Ango kan yadda zaɓen tsakiyar wa'adi ya gudana a Amurka
results.content: Jam’iyyar Democrat ta samu rinjaye a dukkanin majalisun wakilai da Dattijan Amurka yayin zaɓen tsakiyar wa’adin da ƙasar ta gudanar a jiya Talata, inda sakamako ke nuna cewa ta samu kujeru 186 a majalisar wakilai yayinda Republican ta samu kujeru 114 ake kuma dakon sakamakon yankuna 7, can a majalisar dattawar kuma Democrat ɗin ta samu kujeru 52 Republican 40 wanda kuma dama bisa ƙa’ida kujeru 51 ake buƙata gabanin samun rinjaye a wani yanayi da ake dakon sakamakon yanki guda wato kujera 1 da walau ta zama ta ɓangaren adawar ko kuma ta jam’iyya mai mulki.

results.title: Najeriya ta sanar da fara biyan naira dubu 50 ga marasa ƙarfi
results.content: Gwamnatin Najeriya ta sanar da fara bada tallafin kuɗi naira dubu 50 duk wata ga masu ƙaramin ƙarfi a faɗin ƙasar, na tsawon watanni shida, a ƙoƙarin da take yi na rage wa al'umma raɗaɗin matsin rayuwa da suka shiga sakamakon sauye-sauyen tattalin arziƙin da take aiwatarwa. Wakilinnmu Isma'il Karatu Abdullahi ya duba wannan batu, ga rahoton da ya haɗa mana.
